==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Fureyst Sharpsight]] ([[Sacnoth Valley]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Related skills==
*{{skill icon|Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom}}
*{{skill icon|Over the Limit}} ([[elite]])

==Notes==
*This is a [[core]] skill, but [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]] is required to obtain the skill.
*At rank 14 [[Fast Casting]], Time Ward can be maintained constantly without the need for external recharge time modifiers. 
**At rank 12 Fast Casting, Time Ward is self sustaining provided the initial casting is affected by an additional recharge reduction (or a previous cast at 14+ Fast Casting). 

* The AI cannot detect a ward's presence. Although remaining inside the ward would be favourable, even flagged NPC allies will leave the ward's area of effect whilst taking damage or targeting an enemy beyond their spell and attack range.

==Trivia==
*Originally, this reduced recharge times to {{gr|15|20||%}} of their initial values but this was corrected in a hot fix.
*This skill uses the same icon as the ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' [[gw2:Chronomancer|Chronomancer]] skill [[gw2:Rewinder|Rewinder]]. Its functionality is also similar to the Chronomancer [[gw2:well|well skills]].
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
